frame_generation.prompt: EDIT the supplied approved image into ONE technical animation sprite sheet for an actual looping GIF. The supplied image is the edit target and exact appearance reference, not a loose mood reference. Preserve its watercolor/gouache rendering, paper grain, palette, every person's identity and uniform, the complete scene geometry, exact camera angle, crop, exposure and object positions. Produce exactly SIX equal rectangular cells in a 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each cell is a full 4:5 portrait copy of the source composition. Whole sheet aspect ratio is 6:5 landscape. ALL cells have identical framing and scale and touch edge-to-edge, no gutters, no borders, no captions, no frame numbers, no added text. These are consecutive keyframes of ONE very gentle movement loop, not six new illustrations. Hold architecture, faces, clothing patterns, people not explicitly animated, desk objects and all background pixels as consistently identical as possible. Reserve the source's pale upper space exactly as before. No camera movement, no zoom, no scene cuts, no morphing people, no new objects, no change in lighting. Sequence goes neutral, a little positive movement, maximum positive movement, neutral, a little negative movement, maximum negative movement, returning to neutral on repeat. Movement must be visible but small (about 1 percent of the cell width). Animate ONLY the Thai flag's cloth rippling gently around its fixed pole, and the outermost leaf clusters on the left and right trees swaying in a light breeze. Leave the tree trunks, municipal office, pavement, vehicles and all people completely still. The flag must remain a Thai five-horizontal-stripe flag. Maintain source building and people's exact size and placement in every cell.
